errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.subjectNotFound: That person no longer exists in this workspace.
errors.stateInvalid: This request is not in a state where that can be done. Reload and check its status.
errors.legalHold: This request is on legal hold. Release the hold before erasing.
errors.confirmationRequired: Run the preview first and type the confirmation phrase exactly.
errors.exportInProgress: An export of this request is already being prepared.
errors.exportNotReady: That file is not ready or has expired. Prepare a new export.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.validation: Some of the values are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.holdActive: This record is protected and cannot be deleted at the moment.
errors.holdExists: This person already has an active legal hold. Extend it to add another matter.
errors.holdNotFound: This legal hold no longer exists.
errors.holdNotActive: This legal hold has already ended.

typeHint.access: The person asks what data we hold on them. Ends in a file.
typeHint.export: A copy of the person's data. Ends in a file.
typeHint.erasure: Delete the person's data. You preview it first.
typeHint.rectification: Correct data that is wrong. You fix it by hand and close the request.
typeHint.restriction: Stop using the data for now. You handle it by hand and close the request.
typeHint.objection: The person objects to a use of their data. You handle it by hand and close the request.
typeHint.withdrawal: The person withdraws consent. You handle it by hand and close the request.
typeHint.portability: A machine readable copy to move elsewhere. Ends in a file.

method.channel_code: Code sent to the person's channel
method.known_contact: Reached on the number or email we already hold

sla.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
sla.overdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

list.title: Data requests
list.subtitle: Requests from people about the data you hold on them: access, export, erasure and more. Each has a deadline and a record of what was done.

settings.title: Deadline
settings.slaHint: How many days after a request arrives it is due. The default is 30.
settings.invalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 90.

person.title: Find the person
person.search: Search by name, phone or email
person.none: No one found. You can use a phone number or an email below.
person.otherHint: For someone who is not saved. We look for their data by this value.

kind.title: What does the person ask for?

details.title: Details
details.channel: How did the request reach you?
details.noteHint: Optional. Only your team sees this. Do not write personal details here.
details.historyHint: What happens to the person's conversations when their data is erased.
details.historyDelete: Delete the conversations, messages and files
details.historyAnonymise: Keep the conversations without the person's identity

history.anonymise: On erasure: conversations are kept without the person's identity

event.erasure_queued: Erasure confirmed, waiting for the hold to end
event.resume_failed: Automatic erasure failed, run it by hand

verify.title: Identity verification
verify.intro: Check that the person asking is who they say they are before exporting or erasing anything.
verify.evidenceHint: Reference id only, never upload documents. Use a ticket number or a message id.
verify.notVerifiedWarn: A person who is not verified has their request rejected.

hold.title: Legal hold
hold.intro: While a hold is on, erasure is refused. Use it when the law or a dispute requires keeping the data.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Prepares a ZIP file with the data we hold on this person.
export.expiry: A finished file stays available for {days} days, then it is deleted.
export.noEmail: Nothing is sent to the person. Download the file and give it to them through a safe channel.

erase.title: Erase
erase.intro: Deletes the person's data from every module. Preview first: nothing changes until you confirm.
erase.files: {count, plural, one {# stored file queued for deletion} other {# stored files queued for deletion}}
erase.blocked: Erasure is available once the identity is verified and no legal hold is on.

close.title: Close the request
close.completeHint: Use when the person has been answered or the work was done by hand.

legalHold.requesterResponse: We have received your request. We are required to keep some of your data to meet a legal obligation, so we cannot erase it now. We have restricted how it is used and will erase it when the obligation ends. You can lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.
legalHold.contactBanner: Legal hold: erasure and deletion paused
legalHold.workspaceBanner: Legal hold on the whole workspace: erasure and deletion paused
legalHold.blockedMessage: This record is protected and cannot be deleted at the moment.

banner.effects: Marketing, AI processing and exports are restricted, and every access is logged.

place.title: Place a legal hold on this contact
place.workspaceTitle: Place a legal hold on the whole workspace
place.intro: Erasure, deletion and retention clearing of this person are refused while the hold lasts, and marketing, AI processing and exports of their data are restricted. Customer service goes on as usual.
place.workspaceIntro: Every person in the workspace is held: erasure, deletion, retention clearing and the removal of a lapsed workspace are refused, and marketing, AI processing and exports are restricted. Use it for an order that covers all records.
place.caseRefHint: Your own reference: a court file, a ticket, the number on a regulator letter.
place.noteHint: Do not write names, phone numbers or details of the matter here.
place.reviewHint: The register flags the hold when this date passes.
place.expiresHint: After this date the hold ends by itself.
place.searchHint: Type a name, phone number or email address (at least two characters).

release.title: Release this legal hold
release.message: Deletion, retention clearing and marketing can then resume for this subject. Erasure requests waiting on this hold leave the restricted state, and an erasure someone already confirmed runs by itself within a minute.
release.cases: {count, plural, one {# data request is waiting on this hold.} other {# data requests are waiting on this hold.}}
release.reasonHint: Do not write names or details of the matter.
release.doneResuming: {count, plural, one {Legal hold released. # confirmed erasure will run now.} other {Legal hold released. # confirmed erasures will run now.}}

extend.title: Extend this legal hold
extend.addCaseRefHint: A second matter about the same person is added to the same hold.
extend.clearHint: Empty the date to remove it.

review.title: Record a review
review.message: Records that you looked at this hold again, and that it still applies.
review.nextHint: Leave empty to keep the current review date.

register.title: Legal holds
register.subtitle: People and records whose erasure and deletion are paused because the data must be kept. A hold on one person is placed from that contact's page.
register.emptyFiltered: No legal holds match these filters.
register.cases: {count, plural, one {# request waiting} other {# requests waiting}}
register.open: Open the hold with case reference {caseRef}

case.body: This person's data is kept and locked while a legal hold applies. The erasure is not executed, marketing, AI processing and exports are restricted, and the deadline keeps running.
case.requesterHint: States that the data is kept under a legal obligation. It does not say why. Counsel can replace this wording in the privacy settings.
case.queueHint: You can still confirm the erasure now: it is recorded, nothing is erased, and it runs by itself when the hold ends.
case.queue: Confirm erasure for when the hold ends
case.queued: Recorded. Nothing was erased; the erasure will run by itself when the hold ends.

settings.noticeLabel: Answer to a person whose erasure is held back
settings.noticeHint: Your counsel's wording. Leave it empty to use the default text. Do not name the matter or the reason.
